$comment: External-dependency manifest (L1 seed). Schema v2 — design docs/designs/2026-11-07-external-deps-standard-design.md §5.2 (builds on docs/designs/2026-11-07-external-deps-machinery-design.md D1; decision DEC-20261107-02). dependencies is an empty array here: every scaffolded project receives the CONVENTION from day one, and variant templates extend it (merge on id — templates/<variant>/external-deps.json). Fields per dependency: id (unique merge key), repo (https URL, no credentials), pin (release TAG — the contract; branches and bare shas are not supported), commit (resolved sha, advisory drift tripwire — written back at install/update), install (git command template with {pin}/{repo}/{dir} placeholders), install_dir (MUST be external/<id> for a new entry and MUST be gitignored; collisions are refused — R3), consumer (advisory), compatibility_test (run from the project root; exit 0 = pass — required before any pin move), propagation (enum; 'never' only), license (REQUIRED, SPDX id or expression — gated by EXTERNAL_DEP_LICENSE_POLICY in scripts/lib/external-deps.ts: allow / review / review-standalone (GPL as a separate process, needs license_decision) / deny incl. AGPL and any unknown id), usage (REQUIRED, 'as-is' only — the clone is read-only, no upstream file is ever edited), adapter (REQUIRED, the ONE project file that couples to the clone; never under an install_dir), excluded_components (optional [{name, license, reason}] — upstream parts that are never installed), license_decision (optional DEC-YYYYMMDD-NN / ADR-NNNN; required for review classes). Project CLI: bun scripts/external-deps.ts list | install [--id] | verify [--manifest-only] | check-updates. Scaffold fetch: new-project.ts §7.9 (WARN posture; a gated entry is never cloned; --strict-external-deps hard-fails). Upgrade pass: upgrade-project.ts EXTERNAL DEPS (v1 → v2 migration, compat-gated pin move). install_dir content never propagates in either direction (machinery D4).
